leads.claim: A special project group at Wright-Patterson AFB is tasked with identifying unusual objects reported in incidents.
leads.why: The document mentions a project group tasked with identifying objects, but does not explicitly state that physical material from UAPs is in their custody.
leads.government_response: The project group conducts investigations to establish the identity of reported objects.
leads.quote: The continuing efforts of this project are directed toward establishing the identity of each unusual object

doc_verdict: The document contains no evidence of the government obtaining, holding, or analyzing physical UAP material; it only describes administrative procedures for investigating reported incidents.
